## Why it matters

The UN Archives site points researchers to records and photographs created by Secretaries-General, Secretariat departments, field missions, and predecessor international organizations.

Its archival search portal, finding aids, and research guides make it a practical entry point for work on twentieth-century international governance and diplomacy.
